[[File:DisplayScreen-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|A display screen used at Massassi Station]]
A '''display screen''' or '''tracking screen''' was a large, round computer with a flat, circular monitor which allowed for two-dimensional tracking of battles. The [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] possessed one which was used to track the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I's]] approach to Yavin 4.
